name: Plan B: resource optimized
objective: Minimize agents, handoffs, repeated reasoning and CI runs: one continuous lead agent, one fresh reviewer at release candidates, CI batched at checkpoints

scope.acceptance: identical for both plans: every entry of verification-manifest.json; no requirement is dropped or weakened

assumptions: All implementation roles are held by one continuous lead agent (R4-03, AR-021); the fresh reviewer is a separate lane used at T30 and T33 only.
Every task is one unit step: no task duration is known from evidence.
CI is batched: a CI run is planned at each integration checkpoint and verification task, not per task (ADRP-010, AR-022: batching may not suppress a required check).
Repository reads are limited to the compiled package plus the files a task names; the package replaces rediscovery of decisions and contracts.
